description: Source code for a Share Extension's view controller in an iOS app, handling shared content extraction, UI setup, and communication with a gateway service.

classes.name: ShareViewController
classes.description: A UIViewController subclass managing the UI and logic for sharing content from other apps into the OpenClaw service, including content extraction, draft preparation, and message sending.

methods.name: viewDidLoad
methods.description: Initializes the view controller, setting up UI and content size.

methods.name: viewDidAppear
methods.description: Ensures draft is prepared once the view appears.

methods.name: setupUI
methods.description: Configures UI elements, layout constraints, and button actions.

methods.name: prepareDraft
methods.description: Asynchronously extracts shared content, prepares a draft message, and updates UI.

methods.name: handleSendTap
methods.description: Handles user's tap to send the draft message.

methods.name: handleCancelTap
methods.description: Handles user's tap to cancel and dismiss the extension.

methods.name: sendCurrentDraft
methods.description: Validates and sends the current draft message and attachments.

methods.name: sendMessageToGateway
methods.description: Encodes message and attachments, and communicates with the gateway service.

methods.name: shouldRetryWithLegacyClientId
methods.description: Determines if connection should be retried with a legacy client ID based on error.

methods.name: showStatus
methods.description: Displays status messages overlayed in the UI.

methods.name: composeDraft
methods.description: Creates a draft text from the payload, sanitizing undesired content.

methods.name: sanitizeDraftFragment
methods.description: Cleans a string fragment by removing specific banned lines.

methods.name: extractSharedContent
methods.description: Asynchronously extracts shared items, URLs, text, and images from input items.

methods.name: loadImageAttachment
methods.description: Loads image data from provider, compresses to JPEG, and encodes to base64.

methods.name: preferredImageTypeIdentifier
methods.description: Selects the preferred image type identifier from registered types.

methods.name: normalizedJPEGData
methods.description: Converts UIImage to JPEG data with quality adjustments to fit size constraints.

methods.name: loadURL
methods.description: Attempts to load a URL from a provider, via URL or text.

methods.name: loadText
methods.description: Loads textual content from a provider, considering URL and plain text types.

methods.name: loadURLValue
methods.description: Asynchronously loads URL value from provider.

methods.name: loadTextValue
methods.description: Asynchronously loads text from provider.

methods.name: loadDataValue
methods.description: Loads raw data from provider for specified type.
